changelog:
✨ Model Status page: every model behind auto routing with its 24h success rate, requests, median time to first token, output speed and a 60-day health strip.
✨ Auto route: a model that answers too slowly (first token over 20s or under 3 tokens/s, configurable) is skipped for 5 minutes in favour of the rest of its tier, then tried again.
✨ Admin: auto aliases (e.g. hekato-auto) appear in the model pickers; router decisions and learned candidates moved to Model Status so the auto-route Save button is easy to reach.
✨ 模型状态页面：列出自动路由的所有模型，显示 24 小时成功率、请求数、首 token 中位时间、输出速度及 60 天健康记录。
✨ 自动路由：响应过慢的模型（首 token 超过 20 秒或低于 3 tokens/秒，可配置）会被跳过 5 分钟，改用同层级的其他模型，之后再重新尝试。
✨ 管理面板：模型选择器中显示自动别名（如 hekato-auto）；路由决策和已学习候选移至模型状态页面，自动路由的保存按钮更易点击。
